integrity: The analytical proof is presented in RESULT.md. Standalone computational checks are corroborative only. This is self-reviewed, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Independent directions with deterministic equal-length generators in the plane; neither anisotropic or random-length models nor finite-n full distribution or uniform finite-n large deviations are covered. Earlier general degenerate U-statistic theory and inaccessible historic source remain bibliographic priority risks.
title: A non-Gaussian sine-product law for areas of uniformly directed planar zonogons
